args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

round_money claimed to implement banker's rounding but used
ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so ties round to the
nearest even cent (e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68 is fine in binary-free
Decimal land, 2.665 -> 2.66), matching tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- Switched `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so ties round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`).
- Fixes the nightly test failure in `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

## Test plan
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (tests/test_money.py green).

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis**: `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expected banker's rounding (per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` — e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`.
- **Fix**: Created branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` and changed `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (commit `08d3cd5986`).
- **CI**: Triggered run `ci-0001` — it passed.
- **PR**: Opened PR #101 against `main` ("Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, FIN-212)") with alex as the requested reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

I left the PR open (not merged), since merging into main requires code-owner approval.
